body.x: The world's largest technology exhibition CES 2019 will take place from Tuesday, January 8, 2019 to Thursday, November 11, in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. CES is a global showcase for everyone in the technology industry, as well as a high-profile business event that encompasses a wide range of industries and is at the heart of the industry as a business venue where promising companies around the world promote their brands.

The CES, owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association CTA, a technology trade association representing the US consumer technology industry, has more than 3,900 companies, 300 conference sessions worldwide, and 170,000 exhibitors from 150 countries. The CES 2019 will feature products in 24 product categories and more than 20 marketplaces at 11 official venues with an area of ​​2.5 million square feet.

The Eureka Park, which attracts investors, media and participating companies from all over the world, will be held on a larger scale, using all the space in Eureka Park, unlike the last 2018 CES where more than 1,000 start-ups in 45 countries participated .

A Global Stage of Next-Generation Innovations and Demonstration of Breakthrough Technologies Topics covered at CES 2019 include: ▲ 5G ▲ IOT ▲ Block Chain ▲ Wireless Service ▲ Health & Wearable Devices ▲ Smart Home ▲ Sports ▲ Product Packaging ▲ 3D Printing ▲ Artificial Intelligence ▲ Advertising, Entertainment & Contents ▲ 3D Printing ▲ Artificial Intelligence ▲ Robot ▲ Tourism ▲ Drone ▲ Life ▲ Smart City ▲ Automobile, etc. The 2019 CES is expected to focus on Smart City, which received much attention at the 2018 CES.

The world 's largest IT exhibition' CES 'is an exhibition that can grasp the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. A global news network 'AVING NEWS' that most recently reported the issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the last twelve years, has sent a special report team to CES this year to report major issues in the world market and is going to introduce Korean major companies to the world.

On the other hand, AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met. MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
